map.竞争（分析/应对/差异化）是做什么的？: What does Competitive Analysis & Differentiation do?
map.如何使用竞争（分析/应对/差异化）？: How do I use Competitive Analysis & Differentiation?
map.竞争（分析/应对/差异化）适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Competitive Analysis & Differentiation best for?
map.每行输入一条「竞品,价格,份额,增速」。工具计算价格均值、份额合计与增速均值，并: Enter one competitor per line as "competitor,price,share,growth". The tool computes the mean price, total share and mean growth, and identifies the cheapest, highest-share and fastest-growing competitors; a total share near 100% means the sample roughly covers the market.
map.小微商家整理主要竞品的价格、份额与增速，判断自身处于价格带与增长曲线的哪个位置。: Small merchants organise the price, share and growth of their main competitors to see where they sit in the price band and growth curve.
map.制定差异化策略前，先定位价格最低与份额最高的竞品，明确对标对象与避开方向。: Before setting a differentiation strategy, locate the cheapest and highest-share competitors to identify who to benchmark against and which direction to avoid.
map.季度复盘时比较竞品增速均值，判断市场整体处于扩张还是收缩。: In a quarterly review, compare the mean competitor growth to judge whether the market is expanding or contracting overall.
map.输入「竞品A,19.9,32.5,8.0；竞品B,24.6,21.0,-3.5；: Enter "Competitor A,19.9,32.5,8.0; Competitor B,24.6,21.0,-3.5; Competitor C,15.8,18.4,12.6; Competitor D,30.1,12.1,5.2" → mean price 22.60, total share 84.00%, mean growth +5.58%; the cheapest is Competitor C, the highest-share is Competitor A, and the fastest-growing is Competitor C.
map.份额合计不是 100% 有影响吗？: Does a total share below 100% matter?
map.份额合计反映样本覆盖面：接近 100% 说明基本覆盖市场，明显偏低时各项均值只代: The total share reflects how much of the market the sample covers: near 100% means it roughly covers the market, while a clearly low figure means the averages represent only the competitors entered, so conclusions should not be extrapolated.
map.增速为负怎么理解？: How should negative growth be read?
map.表示该竞品同比萎缩，参与均值计算时会拉低整体增速；增速最快项取最大值，可能为负增: It means that competitor shrank year on year, pulling the overall growth down in the mean; the fastest-growing item is the maximum, which may be the best among declines.
map.价格单位需要统一吗？: Must the price unit be consistent?
map.需要，同一份输入内价格必须统一单位与口径（如均为终端零售价），否则均值失去意义。: Yes. Within one input the prices must share the same unit and basis (for example all retail prices), otherwise the mean is meaningless.
map.用结构化维度把竞品量化对标，辅助定位差异化卖点与竞争应对优先级。: Quantify and benchmark competitors along structured dimensions to help locate differentiation selling points and competing-response priorities.
